data.one_liner: Multi-platform audio stream player for raw audio data streams
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that continuously plays buffered, raw float32 multi-channel audio data streams across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web platforms. It uses miniaudio natively and WebAudio on the web.
use_when: You need to play real-time generated or streamed raw PCM audio data in a Flutter application.
You require cross-platform support including all desktop, mobile, and web platforms.
avoid_when: You simply want to play standard pre-recorded audio files like MP3 or WAV from disk or URL.
You need advanced high-level audio playback controls, playlists, or mixing.
strengths: Supports all Flutter platforms including Web, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.
Handles real-time generated raw audio data stream playback efficiently.
Built with high-performance miniaudio library for native platforms.
weaknesses: Limited to raw float32 multi-channel audio data streams.
Requires manual buffer and stream management.
data.setup_notes: For developers cloning the repository, the miniaudio submodule must be updated using git submodule update --init. On the web platform, resume() must be called after user interaction.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick just_audio if you need feature-rich playback for standard audio files and URLs rather than low-level raw audio streaming.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick audioplayers for simpler playback of audio files and simple sound effects across platforms.
